# Candidate Show HN post

Title: Show HN: One click flight booking in Claude
Project URL: https://mcp.bonbook.co/claude-setup
Posted (UTC): 2026-10-20T23:36:17Z

## Project page text (fetch status: ok)

```text
Three steps. About one minute. No account or password.
Open Claude
and go to
Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector
.
Paste this address
into the URL box and click
Add
.
Copy
Name it
BonBook Travel
. Leave everything else empty.
Click Connect.
A BonBook page appears for a second and closes by itself. You're done.
Now start a new chat and ask for a flight, for example:
Find me a flight from Austin to Los Angeles next Friday, one way.
Your first booking opens a secure bonbook.co checkout page. After that, just say “book option 2”.
```

## HN discussion (2 comments)

- [other] arlattimore: Who processes the booking & payment, an aggregator like Expedia or the airlines direct?
- [author] themagyar: Airlines process and charge your card directly. So a booking on Delta shows up as 'Delta Air Lines' and you keep credit card points.

<think>Let me evaluate this candidate.

**Product:** BonBook — a Claude custom connector that lets you book flights via chat with "one click."

**What it does:** You set it up in Claude as a custom connector. Then you can ask "Find me a flight from Austin to Los Angeles next Friday," and you can book by saying "book option 2."

**Key features:**
- Uses MCP (Model Context Protocol) to let Claude search and book flights
- Airlines process and charge the card directly (no aggregator markup, keep credit card points)
- No account/password needed

**Decision:** This is a `push`. It's a nice small product — a clean, practical use of the Model Context Protocol to let you book flights via natural language chat, with a clever touch that airlines charge directly (so you keep points). The project page is clear and simple. It's a useful sample of what people are building now with MCP.

Reason: A nice small product that uses the Model Context Protocol to let you book flights via natural language chat, with a clever detail: airlines charge your card directly, so you keep credit card points.</think>{"decision": "push", "reason": "这是一个用 Model Context Protocol 构建的小产品，让你通过自然语言直接在 Claude 里预订机票；亮点是机票费用由航空公司直接收取，所以你还能拿到信用卡积分。" }
